program_name: Intel 8051 - LCD and LED Interfacing Ex 7
objective: Execute 8051 lcd and led interfacing program 7 using Internal RAM.
theory: The Intel 8051 is an 8-bit Harvard architecture microcontroller featuring 4 KB on-chip ROM, 128 bytes internal RAM, 32 I/O lines, and 2 timers.
algorithm: 1. Read internal RAM byte from address 30H into Accumulator A.
2. Load immediate byte 07H into Register R0.
3. Add R0 to A (ADD A, R0).
4. Store result into internal RAM address 31H.
flowchart: START -> Execute LCD and LED Interfacing Step 1 -> Process Data -> Verify Flags/Result -> END
assembly_code:
; 8051 Microcontroller - LCD and LED Interfacing Ex 7
MOV A, 30H
MOV R0, #07H
ADD A, R0
MOV 31H, A
END
